name: nse-trading-toolkit
description: NSE Trading Toolkit: Claude skills for trading Indian stocks (NSE / BSE, Zerodha Kite)

plugins.name: nse-trading-toolkit
plugins.description: Eleven Claude skills for trading NSE and BSE stocks: a chart scanner, a news monitor with NSE announcements, an entry timer, an exit planner, a time machine that replays 10,000 sessions, a risk manager, a budget manager with Zerodha charges, a Kite order executor (paper by default, never without your yes), price alerts, an insider and bulk / block deal tracker, and a swing trader with a near-breakout scan, GTT stops and a costed backtest.
